caption: The video captures an outdoor bonfire already burning when the excerpt opens, its flame anchored at the top of a cone of long branches and logs. A tall orange-yellow column of fire rises from the pile, its height, width, and lean shifting continuously from frame to frame. At one point the plume broadens and tilts left, forming a puffy flare near its tip before thinning into a narrower stream. A faint trail of smoke drifts upward above the flame's crown, changing shape as it rises. The branches and logs beneath the fire hold their position and shape throughout, with no visible collapse or settling. To the right, a green-roofed open shelter and a stack of cut logs remain fixed, as does a small white jug on the lower left grass. The surrounding trees and pale dusk sky hold their positions, indicating a still camera. The fire persists steadily across the clip, neither growing nor dying out.
